changes: Create voice channels! Click the # next to the new-channel box to switch it to 🔊
New notification sound: a proper ba-bloop instead of the Windows ding (for Jon)
Server icons: admins can set one in Settings → Server — shows in the server rail
Uploads now expire to keep the server's disk in check — 3 weeks by default
Admins can pick the retention window in Settings → Server (3 weeks / 1 / 2 / 3 months)
Avatars and stickers never expire
See who's in a voice channel right in the sidebar, without joining (thanks space_goat)
@everyone pings the whole server — use responsibly or get banned by the admin
Server rail: the app can now hold multiple servers — click + on the far left to add one, click circles to switch
Servers have names now — admins can rename theirs in Settings → Server
The sidebar shows the server's actual name instead of 'NotDiscord'
System tray: closing the window keeps NotDiscord running in the tray
The tray icon gets a red badge when you have unread messages
Left-click the tray to bring the window back; right-click → Quit to actually exit
This screen! After every update you'll see what changed
Browse recent version history any time from Settings → App → What's new
Push-to-talk: pick a key in Settings → Voice — works even while you're in a game
Deafen button in the voice panel (silences everyone + mutes you)
Real settings menu: gear button in the bottom-left, tabs for Voice and App
Notification sounds can be turned off in Settings → App
Direct messages! Click someone in the members list → Message
DMs are private end to end — server enforced, admins can't peek
Every DM pings you like an @mention
Roles: admin & member, with ADMIN badges — admins can delete messages/channels, promote, and ban
Update downloads stream with a progress bar and no longer stall
RNNoise ML noise suppression (keyboard clatter begone) — toggle in voice settings
Mic volume, output volume, and a live mic meter
Update splash screen; updating mid-call now leaves voice cleanly
Proper SVG icons everywhere instead of emoji buttons
Bare URLs are clickable; right-click copy/paste works
webm/mp4 links play inline like GIFs
Dark scrollbars
Pasted/dropped files show a preview before sending (Enter to send, Esc to cancel)
Per-friend volume sliders and instant speaking rings in voice
The auto-updater itself — this is why you never reinstall manually anymore
Custom stickers: upload once, spam forever
Nightly server backups
